database_summary: Small cricket match dataset containing players, teams, matches and ball-level events (ball_by_ball) plus specialized event/detail tables for runs by batsmen, wickets and extras. mix of descriptive dimension-like tables (player, team, match) and high-cardinality event/measurement tables (ball_by_ball, batsman_scored, wicket_taken, extra_runs). Schema is SQLite and foreign-key relationships are implied by column names (e.g. player_id, team_id, match_id) but not explicitly declared in DDL. Several tables use composite natural keys (match, over, ball, innings) but DDL marks many columns as PRIMARY KEY incorrectly (appears to intend composite PKs).

accepted.name: player_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  dob,
  batting_hand,
  bowling_skill,
  country_name
FROM player
accepted.description: Normalized player dimension: one row per player, canonicalizing obvious attributes. Use when you need player descriptive attributes for joins, labeling, or aggregations. | Use for: Lookups for player name/attributes by player_id; Filtering players by country, batting_hand, or bowling_skill; Joining player attributes onto event facts (balls, wickets, matches)

accepted.name: team_dim
accepted.description: Normalized team dimension: one row per team. Use for team labels and joins to match or event tables. | Use for: Retrieve team names by team_id; Join team names into match-level or event-level reports

accepted.name: match_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  team_1,
  team_2,
  match_date,
  season_id,
  venue,
  toss_winner,
  toss_decision,
  win_type,
  win_margin,
  outcome_type,
  match_winner,
  man_of_the_match
FROM "match"
accepted.description: Match-level dimension: one row per match with key descriptive attributes. Useful as the base match relation for season/venue/toss/winner analyses. | Use for: Season-level counts, venue-based summaries, filtering matches by outcome or toss decision; Joining matches to teams or player participation

accepted.name: player_match_participation
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  player_id,
  role,
  team_id
FROM player_match
accepted.description: One row per player-match participation with the player's role and team in that match. Use when joining players to matches or computing per-player per-match metrics. | Use for: Which players played in a given match or season; Aggregate player appearances by season or team; Filter players by role (e.g., Captain)

accepted.name: ball_event
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  team_batting,
  team_bowling,
  striker_batting_position,
  striker,
  non_striker,
  bowler
FROM ball_by_ball
accepted.description: Canonical ball-level event row: one row per ball identified by match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, with batting/bowling players and teams. Use as the primary fact table for ball-level analyses and to join other ball-level event tables. | Use for: Ball-level aggregations: runs per over, balls faced by a batsman, bowler analysis; Joining batsman_scored, wicket_taken, extra_runs to assemble full ball outcomes

accepted.name: batsman_run_event
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  runs_scored
FROM batsman_scored
accepted.description: Batsman runs recorded at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with runs_scored. Use to compute batsman-level totals or to join to ball_event for full-event context. | Use for: Compute runs per batsman per match/season when joined to player/player_match; Ball-level run distributions (dot balls vs scoring events)

accepted.name: wicket_event
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  player_out,
  kind_out
FROM wicket_taken
accepted.description: Wicket events at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with player_out and kind_out. Use to count dismissals, join to players or balls, and analyze dismissal types. | Use for: Count wickets by bowler or fielder when joined appropriately; Analyze dismissal types over time or by venue

accepted.name: extra_event
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  extra_type,
  extra_runs
FROM extra_runs
accepted.description: Extra runs at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with extra_type and extra_runs. Use to include extras when computing total runs or distinguishing batsman runs from extras. | Use for: Compute total extras by type for innings/match; Include extras when deriving total runs per innings or per over

accepted.name: ball_event_full
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker_batting_position,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker,
  b.bowler,
  bs.runs_scored,
  er.extra_type,
  er.extra_runs,
  w.player_out,
  w.kind_out
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = b.match_id AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no AND er.over_id = b.over_id AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
accepted.description: Denormalized ball-level event: one row per ball combining ball_by_ball, batsman_scored, extra_runs, and wicket_taken where present. Use for analyses that need complete event context without repeatedly joining the event tables. | Use for: Compute total runs per over/inning including extras; Per-ball summaries for visualization or event sequence reconstruction; Bowler/batsman metrics at ball-level with dismissal and extra context

accepted.name: player_match_batting_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  COUNT(1) AS balls_faced,
  SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_scored
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.striker
accepted.description: Aggregated batting summary per player per match: total runs_scored and balls_faced (count of ball events where player was striker). Use to compute per-match batting performance for players. | Use for: Per-match batting aggregates for leaderboards; Compute strike rates when combined with runs and balls

accepted.name: bowler_match_wickets
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler
accepted.description: Aggregated wicket counts per bowler per match: number of wickets taken. Use for match- or season-level bowler performance when joined to match or player. | Use for: Count wickets per bowler per match or aggregate to season; Identify top wicket-takers in a match or season

accepted.name: innings_total_runs
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.match_id,
  be.innings_no,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(be.extra_runs,0)) AS total_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.runs_scored,0)) AS batsman_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.extra_runs,0)) AS extras
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    b.ball_id,
    bs.runs_scored,
    er.extra_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = b.match_id AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no AND er.over_id = b.over_id AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
) be
GROUP BY
  be.match_id,
  be.innings_no
accepted.description: Total runs per innings including batsman runs and extras. Use to compute innings totals and to join with match to get match-level scoring outcomes. | Use for: Compute innings totals for scorecards; Compare batsman contribution vs extras by innings or match

accepted.name: player_career_aggregates
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(pr.runs_scored,0)) AS career_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bw.wickets,0)) AS career_wickets
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    b.striker AS player_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_scored
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.striker
) pr ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    b.bowler AS player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.bowler
) bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
accepted.description: Career aggregates per player across all matches: total runs (from batsman_scored when player was striker) and total wickets (when player appeared as bowler and wicket recorded). Use for career leaderboards and per-player summaries. | Use for: Career leaderboards for runs and wickets; Player summary cards combining batting and bowling aggregates

accepted.name: match_team_roles
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.team_1 AS team_id,
  1 AS is_team_1,
  0 AS is_team_2,
  CASE WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team_1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_toss_winner,
  CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match_winner
FROM "match" m
UNION ALL
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.team_2 AS team_id,
  0 AS is_team_1,
  1 AS is_team_2,
  CASE WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_toss_winner,
  CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match_winner
FROM "match" m
accepted.description: One row per match-team role: emits one row for each referenced team in a match (team_1, team_2, toss_winner, match_winner) with role flags. Use to analyze team participation per match and to count wins/tosses by team. | Use for: Count wins/tosses by team, filter matches by team participation, join to team_dim for team names
